title: Coherent compact-support reduction tower functor
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, $X,Y$ finite-type $K_0$-schemes, and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and put $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the small pro-etale sites and coefficient universes of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For a scheme $W$ write $B_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_W$ for the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $\mathcal A_W=\operatorname{Mod}(B_W)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $D(\mathcal A_W)=D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A_Y)$ be the abelian category of strict inverse sequences, with compatible levelwise maps and levelwise exactness [def-weil-inverse-system, lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. Choose one compactification $c=(j,p)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and let $Rf^{c}_{!,n}=Rp_{*,n}j_!$ on $(A_n)$-module derived categories [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For $K\in D(\mathcal A_X)$ let $K_n=K\otimes^L_{B_X}(A_n)_X$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $\operatorname{Res}_n$ be restriction of scalars along $B_Y\to(A_n)_Y$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], applied termwise to complexes; it is exact by [lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact].

There is an exact $R$-linear functor lifting the composite of derived reduction, extension by zero along $j$, the separately derived proper direct image $Rp_*$, and restriction of coefficients, with the scalar action induced by the compatible constant sections $R\to\Gamma(W_{\mathrm{proet}},B_W)$:
$$
\mathcal T_f^c:D(\mathcal A_X)\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y))
$$
[def-weil-linear-functor, def-weil-triangulated-category]. Its $n$-th evaluation is naturally isomorphic to $\operatorname{Res}_nRf^{c}_{!,n}K_n$, including on morphisms. Under these identifications its transition from $n+1$ to $n$ is $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}$ of $Rf^{c}_{!,n+1}$ applied to the quotient-induced map $K_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}^{A_{n+1}}_{A_n}K_n$, followed by the coefficient-restriction comparison of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] and $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}\operatorname{Res}^{A_{n+1}}_{A_n}=\operatorname{Res}_n$. For every $m\geq n\geq1$ these identifications carry the composite transition from $m$ to $n$ to the map induced by $A_m\twoheadrightarrow A_n$ and the coefficient-restriction comparison; the identifications are natural in $K$.

proof.text: Apply the sequence-projection lemma on each site with $B_n=(A_n)_W$ and $B=B_W$. Write $\mathcal R_X=L\pi_X^*$. Its single K-flat system has evaluations $K\otimes^L_{B_X}(A_n)_X=K_n$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and quotient maps $d_{m,n}=1\otimes q_{m,n}$, with $\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}d_{n,k}\circ d_{m,n}=d_{m,k}$ before localization.

proof.text: The constant-ring isomorphisms for $j,p$ preserve quotients: both maps agree on constant sections. Apply the open-system lemma to obtain $J$. Set $G=Rp_{*,\bullet}$. The DVR lemma gives $\varpi\ne0$ in the subring $R\subset E$, hence a non-zero-divisor; the profinite-tower lemma gives $R\cong\lim A_n$. Thus the system comparison applies and gives $e_nG\cong Rp_{*,n}e_n$.

proof.text: Set $\mathcal T_f^c=D(U_Y)G D(J)\mathcal R_X$. Evaluating its four factors gives $e_n\mathcal T_f^c\cong\operatorname{Res}_nRp_{*,n}j_!K_n=\operatorname{Res}_nRf^c_{!,n}K_n$, naturally on morphisms. Exact descent and K-injective right derivation are triangulated, as is $L\pi_X^*$. The composite theorem equips $\mathcal T_f^c$ with the composite shift isomorphism.

proof.text: Put $F_n=Rf^c_{!,n}$. Apply the new restriction-transition lemma to $p$ and $D(J)\mathcal R_XK$. Its K-injective normalization is the value clause of [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars] for the proper map $p$ and $A_m\to A_n$, i.e. the proper comparison used in $\chi$, since both natural isomorphisms agree on K-injective representatives; the open-system lemma identifies its input transition. Hence the evaluated tower transition is $t_{m,n}=\operatorname{Res}_m(\chi_{m,n,K_n}\circ F_m(d_{m,n}))$, exactly the specified map.

proof.text:
Before restriction to $B_Y$, write $r_{m,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$. For $m\ge n\ge k$, naturality at $d_{n,k}$ and the coefficient-composition law give
$$r_{m,n}(\chi_{n,k,K_k})\,r_{m,n}F_n(d_{n,k})\,\chi_{m,n,K_n}\,F_m(d_{m,n})
=r_{m,n}(\chi_{n,k,K_k})\,\chi_{m,n,r_{n,k}K_k}\,F_m(r_{m,n}d_{n,k})\,F_m(d_{m,n})
=\chi_{m,k,K_k}\,F_m(r_{m,n}d_{n,k}\circ d_{m,n})
=\chi_{m,k,K_k}\,F_m(d_{m,k}).$$
Apply $\operatorname{Res}_m$ to obtain $t_{n,k}\circ t_{m,n}=t_{m,k}$. Identity quotients give identities; induction identifies successive composites with the direct quotient. These identify the evaluated transitions of the already constructed system, with no inference that evaluations detect equality of arbitrary system morphisms. All constituent comparisons are natural in $K$.

proof.text: Compatible constant sections of $R$ act on all ringed sites. Apply the two new scalar lemmas to $L\pi_X^*$ and $G$. The open lemma gives scalar preservation for $J$; $U_Y$ keeps the same additive maps and scalar actions. Exact linear descent gives linearity of $D(J),D(U_Y)$. Thus all four factors, and their composite, are $R$-linear for the induced scalar structures.
